steps: Close the game before preparing its VR setup. Use the install button at the top; AVRcade downloads UEVR, its runtime and the reviewed game profile automatically.

If the profile download fails, use View profile source and obtain the reviewed profile ZIP. Choose Import VR profile ZIP here; AVRcade validates and places its files. Do not unpack it into the game folder.
For VR + mods, set -dx11 in your selected mod manager. The ordinary AVRcade VR launch supplies this option itself.
Connect the headset and start its runtime. Recheck setup after changing files or updating the game. Installed packages do not establish compatibility with a newer game build.
Close the game and use the install button at the top. AVRcade downloads the pinned UEVR tools, runtime and reviewed profile automatically.

If the profile download fails, use View profile source and obtain its reviewed ZIP. Choose Import VR profile ZIP; AVRcade validates and installs it in the correct profile folder. Do not extract it into the game directory.
Start your headset runtime before launching. Experimental tracked hands are optional; they are not required to finish package installation.

This route requires both UUVR and the AVRcade YAPYAP bridge. A generic UUVR install alone does not complete this game's setup. Follow the linked AVRcade bridge package instructions for the supported build, then choose Recheck setup.
Use SteamVR for headset play, including when Virtual Desktop provides the connection. Package installation and headset connection are reported separately.
For VR + mods, use a manager profile containing both UUVR and the AVRcade bridge. Select a separate profile without those VR plugins for monitor mods. Close the game before switching modes.
Locate your installed classic Windows game if it was not found. The bridge supports one specific executable build; the status above explains a build mismatch.
Close the game and use Install VR bridge at the top. AVRcade places its bridge and OpenXR loader beside the supported game executable.
For Vanilla, choose a separate clean game folder in the Mods tab when requested. Do not copy a different VR mod over the managed bridge to clear a setup error.
Close GTA IV and use Install VR package at the top. AVRcade checks the supported executable and downloads the configured package.
Use the startup and input settings below to select your headset controls. Connect through SteamVR, then choose Recheck setup after an external change.
If the build check blocks installation, use the supported game version named in the status. Installing a second VR conversion over the managed files will not resolve a mismatch.
Use the supported GTA V Legacy build shown in the status; this package does not support Enhanced. Close the game and use Install VR package at the top.
Complete normal Rockstar sign-in. Disable BattlEye in Rockstar Launcher for Story Mode, then select the runtime and controller mode in the settings below.
Keep the package for Story Mode. If setup fails, resolve the reported build or file conflict before retrying; do not add another VR conversion over it.
This is an experimental native VR route. Read the supported build and preparation status above before attempting a headset launch.
Use this page's Fallout preparation and Vortex controls for the native adapter. A community VR mod ZIP cannot be imported through the generic installer.
Close the game before changing its setup. Choose Recheck setup after preparation and confirm the result in the headset; installed files alone are not a headset validation.
Use Set up New Vegas VR and Vortex sync on this page. The setup dialog checks the game, native prerequisites and optional one-way Vortex synchronization.
Resolve each preparation error in the dialog, then close it and choose Recheck setup. Avoid copying an unrelated VR package into the game folder.
The native VR route is experimental. After preparation, connect the headset and use the native headset-test launch; package status does not imply that this hardware test has passed.
